description: Land Acquisition - Order to acquire the land in Kongaswala in Mawathagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimants. The document is an official order for taking possession of lands, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land acquisitions and property-related administrative actions.
